home.title: A puzzle is waiting for you today. Ready?

auth.forgot_help: A new password is set with the reminder word from sign-up.
auth.reminder_help: If the password is forgotten, this word is asked. A word that stays in mind is enough.
auth.reset_missing: The link is missing. Ask for a new one from the login page.

games.title: Games
games.loadError: Games could not be loaded. Is the backend running?
games.waking: The server was asleep and is waking up. On a phone this can take a minute.

play.crossHint: The first touch fills, the second leaves ×, the third clears. × is only a note and is ignored when checking.
play.edgeCrossHint: The first touch is a fence, the second leaves ×, the third clears. × edges are ignored when checking.
play.notesHint: With Notes on, a digit stays small. The final number is written with Notes off.
play.correct: In place. The puzzle is complete.
play.incorrectCells: Some cells are not in place yet.
play.rejected: The score was not saved. The solution could not be verified.
play.loadingSlow: The server is waking up and the puzzle is being prepared. This can take a minute.
play.unavailable: The puzzle could not be opened. It can be opened again in a moment.
play.noFit: This piece does not fit that way. It can be turned, or another cell can be tried.
play.anchor: A piece is chosen, turned, then set on the cell it covers. A filled cell lifts that piece.
play.noScores: No saved scores for this game yet.

gameRules.kakuro: Digits in each white run are different and add up to the clue above or to the left.
gameRules.sudoku: Each row, column, and bold box contains the digits 1–9 once.
gameRules.bolgesel-sudoku: Each row, column, and colored region contains the digits 1–4 once.
gameRules.apartman: Each row and column contains heights 1–4 once. An edge number is how many buildings you can see from that side.
gameRules.cit: A number says how many of that cell's edges belong to the line. The line is one closed loop. An empty cell has no number.
gameRules.amiral-batti: A row or column number is how many ship cells sit on that line. Ships do not touch.
gameRules.sihirli-piramit: The path starts at the top and reaches the base with one circle on each row. A step only touches the neighboring circle below. Each number from 1 up to the number of rows appears once.
gameRules.patika: The numbered dots form a continuous path of horizontal and vertical steps.
gameRules.abc-baglama: Matching letters join with horizontal and vertical lines that do not cross.
gameRules.islem-karesi: Each row and each column reaches the result on the right or below, using the signs between the numbers. Multiplication and division come before addition and subtraction. The numbers are 1–9, each once.
gameRules.kendoku: Each row and column contains 1–{{n}} once. Cages use addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division.
gameRules.yildiz-savaslari: One star stands in each row, column, and colored region. Stars do not touch, even diagonally.
gameRules.kare-karalamaca: Row and column numbers are the lengths of consecutive shaded groups.
gameRules.carpmaca: Each cell is the product of its row header and column header.
gameRules.futoshiki: Each row and column contains 1–{{n}} once. The < and > signs order neighboring cells.
gameRules.pentominolar: The five-square pieces cover the outlined area with no gaps or overlaps. A piece is chosen, turned, and set on the grid.
gameRules.metaforms: Each shape and each color is used once. A piece drawn in one cell belongs there. Hatched cells are where it may go. A red cross means it stays out of those cells. An empty shape may be any color. A color alone may be any shape.
gameRules.numbers: Starred cells fill the equation underneath, left to right and top to bottom. A/B = C/D reads four stars in that same order. Every cell is a number from 1 to 9.
gameRules.colours: Each palette piece is used once. The other cells stay empty. A check or a question mark means filled. A cross means empty. A card with a slash is a picture that does not occur.
